name: CRISPR-engineered yeast and bacteria for raw materials production

mentions.name: CRISPR-engineered yeast and bacteria for raw materials production
mentions.description: This project engineers yeast and bacteria using CRISPR to produce raw materials critical for European sovereignty. The team is still deciding which specific organism and material to target.
mentions.problem: Europe needs sovereign access to critical raw materials.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am geoengineering yeast and bacteria using CRISPR to produce raw materials critical for European sovereignty.
